events.description: 3D Starfield Initialization and Camera Rotation: A glowing Sun is placed at the center, surrounded by a 3D cloud of stars, with the camera continuously rotating around them.
events.clip_query: A 3D starfield rotating around a central glowing sun

events.description: Stellar Distance Measurements: Lines are drawn from the Sun to various stars, accompanied by dynamic 'L.Y.' labels that rotate to face the camera.
events.clip_query: Lines extending from the center to stars with distance labels in light years

events.description: Star Colorization: The stars transition from solid white to a spectrum of stellar colors based on their color index.
events.clip_query: Stars in a 3D cluster changing color from white to blue, yellow, and red

events.description: H.R. Diagram Morphing: The camera resets to 2D, axes fade in, and the stars morph from their 3D spatial coordinates into a 2D scatter plot sorted by color and brightness.
events.clip_query: Stars morphing from a 3D cluster into a 2D scatter plot on a coordinate system
